pr.title: Optimize header layout performance with flexbox mixins

raw_findings.body: Once `.small-action` becomes a flex container its children are flex items, so `float: right` on the button is ignored; the button renders inline immediately after the description instead of being right-aligned.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Visual layout regression: action button no longer right-aligned.
raw_findings.impact: Once `.small-action` becomes a flex container its children are flex items, so `float: right` on the button is ignored; the button renders inline immediately after the description instead of being right-aligned.
raw_findings.root_cause: Converting `.small-action` to flexbox without updating child elements that depend on floating for right alignment.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Give `.small-action button` `margin-left: auto` (the same technique applied to `.panel` in header.scss) or otherwise reposition it via flex layout instead of relying on float.
raw_findings.title: Making .small-action a flex container nullifies its child button's float: right
raw_findings.trigger: Rendering a small-action system post (e.g. "closed this topic") whose `.small-action button` still relies on `float: right` (unchanged lines below) to sit at the right edge of the row.

raw_findings.body: `-ms-align-items` is not a real CSS property (IE10's tweener syntax uses `-ms-flex-align`, already emitted on the line above), so this declaration is ignored by every browser and is dead output bytes.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Misleading dead code that suggests non-existent cross-browser support.
raw_findings.impact: `-ms-align-items` is not a real CSS property (IE10's tweener syntax uses `-ms-flex-align`, already emitted on the line above), so this declaration is ignored by every browser and is dead output bytes.
raw_findings.root_cause: Introduced a non-existent vendor-prefixed property in the mixin.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Remove the `-ms-align-items: $alignment;` line; the `-ms-flex-align` declaration already provides the IE10 fallback.
raw_findings.title: Invalid vendor property -ms-align-items in align-items mixin
raw_findings.trigger: Any call to the new `align-items()` mixin compiles this declaration into output CSS.
